I’m writing about the Plus charge associated with order #917776. The short version is that my card was charged after the free trial, and I’d like to know what period that payment covers. One sensor is in that room and the other is in the living room, where my daughter has decided the little shelf it sits on is also a perfectly reasonable place to keep her collection of interesting rocks. The thermostat has been doing its job, and the household has more or less stopped debating whether the hallway feels colder than the living room. This counts as progress around here.

I signed up for the Plus trial on a Sunday while waiting for a loaf of bread to finish baking. When the charge appeared, I checked the app, then the original shop email, then the card statement again, as though looking at it in a different order might make the billing dates appear. No such luck.

input:
After a few weeks with the current layout, honestly I preferred the old app design. I liked how the thermostat and the room readings sat together on the old home screen. The new layout is fine, and I know where everything is now. I just liked the way the previous one looked and felt when I opened it for a quick glance.

We’ve had our Jebrova thermostat for about three years. We put it in not long after moving into this house, then added the hub and a couple of room sensors that autumn. The sensor in the back room gets the most attention, mostly because that’s where we sit after dinner. My commute is a bus ride and a ten-minute walk, so I tend to open the app while I’m waiting at the stop on the way home. On Saturdays I usually look at it while the kettle is on, before anyone else has come downstairs.

I gave the new layout a fair go. I spent a Sunday morning looking through the tabs over coffee, and for a while I made a point of checking the room readings the new way instead of going straight to the thermostat. It feels familiar now, so it’s not really a matter of getting used to it. I still prefer the quieter look of the old screen, especially first thing in the morning.

cues: honestly I preferred the old app design
